title: CSS Box Shadow Generator
h1: CSS Box Shadow Generator — Offset, Blur, Spread
seoTitle: CSS Box Shadow Generator — Copy-Ready Shadow
description: Build a CSS box-shadow from offset, blur, spread, color and inset, then copy the declaration. Preview values update locally in the browser.
intro: Adjust the shadow controls and generate a box-shadow declaration you can paste into a stylesheet. No design account is required.
blurb: Generate a CSS box-shadow declaration from offset, blur, spread and color.
howItWorks: Set horizontal and vertical offsets, blur and spread in pixels.
Enter a hex color and an opacity from 0 to 100. Check inset for an inner shadow.
Press Generate CSS to get a box-shadow declaration ready to paste.
examples: 0 8px 24px with 25% opacity is a soft drop shadow under a card.
Inset with a small blur darkens the inner edge of an input.
A negative spread pulls the shadow inward so it does not spill past rounded corners.

faq.a: Use a 3 or 6 digit hex color such as #0f172a. Opacity is applied separately as an rgba alpha.
This generator emits one shadow. Paste several declarations together with commas if you need a stack.

faq.q: Does it call a design API?
faq.a: No. The CSS string is built locally in the page.
